verdict.rationale: The docs describe running Stagehand against a local Chromium browser (localBrowser.launch) or attaching over CDP to a browser you already run, with persistent local user-data directories. This means the core automation can run on your own infrastructure instead of the Browserbase cloud. However, caching is described as server-side, and observability and region features are tied to Browserbase, so it is unclear whether the full product can run self-hosted. missing for 10: evidence of an open-source license or repository, explicit self-hosting documentation, confirmation that server-side features like caching work without Browserbase, independent hands-on corroboration of a fully self-hosted deployment.
